method: Actual Zod schemas parsed JSON returned by an isolated PostgreSQL test cluster with migration 0022 and test fixtures.
reproduction: Export the same RPC fixture results as keys detalhe, historico, lista, metodos and opcoes; parse detalhe/historico with estudoDetalheSchema and every registros item with estudoListaRow/metodoEstudoVersaoRow/opcaoEstudoRow respectively.
limits: Only synthetic data in an isolated local PostgreSQL cluster was used.
This checks SQL-to-TypeScript DTO compatibility, not connected Supabase Auth, Storage HTTP, remote migration application or operational data.
Migration 0022 was still under review when this fixture export was produced; later SQL security changes require their own database checks.
